a: lengthTable measures a straight segment as length 0 when its squared length over- or underflows
3D `len` and `distance` overflow and underflow where `normalize` does not
Quadratic and NURBS curve reps zero a small curve's curvature on an absolute threshold; the cubic rep judges it by scale
pathCrossings never finds a cubic segment crossing itself
b: nearestPointsRayLine pairs a zero-direction line (a point) with the ray's origin instead of the ray's nearest point to it
pathCrossings never tests a segment against itself, so a looped cubic's self-crossing is never reported
The curve representations' `toPath` write world coordinates straight into a Float32Array with no `origin`, losing precision far from the origin
A subpath opened after `Z` without an `M` restarts at the previous subpath's anchor id, so the length table's anchor breakpoints stop ascending and its anchor queries answer on the wrong subpath
